name: dsh-github
description: GitHub integration for DSH: pull request, issue, repository and file tools, a review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, and a reusable GitHub Action, with every write gated by human approval.
longDescription: DSH 的 GitHub 集成：PR / Issue / 仓库 / 文件工具，带幂等行内评论与状态门禁的审查机器人，以及可复用的 GitHub Action；写操作全部人工审批。
